resources.string:
BoitierTube is a desktop application for discovering, searching and playing online video content.

It offers a simple, smooth and accessible experience, with a modern, customizable interface designed for computers.

BoitierTube emphasizes ease of use, comfortable navigation and user control.

Source code, issue tracking and contributions.

BoitierTube does not connect directly to your Google account for privacy and security. To bring your YouTube subscriptions here:

1. Open takeout.google.com and export YouTube → subscriptions (subscriptions.csv), or use a NewPipe subscriptions.json file.
2. Click Choose File below to import all channels locally.
